meaning: letter d, as in chá-daa (dancer's crown)
note: Mid class, rare. Sounds like ด; at the end of a syllable it is a held t.

meaning: letter dt, as in bpà-dtàk (goad, spear)
note: Mid class, rare. Sounds like ต; at the end of a syllable it is a held t.

ปฏิ is bpà-dtì again; ธ at the end is a held t.

ด mid class + ำ am. ำ is short but ends in m, so it acts like a long vowel: mid tone.
จ mid class + ะ short a, after. Mid class, short vowel: low tone.
ต mid class + เ-ะ short e, around. Low tone.

ถ high class + ือ long uue: ื above, อ after. Rising tone.
ห high class + ัว long uua. Rising tone.
ส high class + เ-ือ long uuea, in three pieces. Rising tone.
ส high class + เ-ีย long iia, in three pieces. Rising tone.
ส high class + ใ ai, written first. ใ acts like a long vowel: rising tone.

meaning: letter ch, as in chooe (tree, an old word)
note: Low class, the rarest letter in use. Sounds like ช.

note: Low class, rare. Usually th like ท; in a few words it is said d.

meaning: letter th, as in phûu-thâo (old man)
note: Low class, rare. Sounds like ท.

meaning: letter l, as in jù-laa (star-shaped kite)
note: Low class, rare. Sounds like ล; at the end of a syllable it is n.

ป mid class + เ-ิ ooe + final ด, a held t. Dead: low tone.

ง low class + เ-ิ (the vowel of เธอ, said short in this word) + final น n. Live: mid tone.

ช low class + ออ long aaw + final บ, a held p. Dead, long vowel: falling tone.
พ low class + long uu + final ด, a held t. Dead, long: falling tone.

ว low class + ั short a + final ด, a held t. Dead, short: high tone.

ผ high class + long aa + ้: falling tone.
